objective: Replace the integrated Codex implementation with HIA-native owners, verify its existing behavior, then retire superseded implementations.

baseline.inventory_scope: Git tree paths and blob identities. The counts include production, tests, fixtures, examples and support code; they are not per-file source review or qualification results.
baseline.crate_count_rule: Every Cargo.toml under codex-rs, including the workspace manifest and nested fixture manifests. This is not the Cargo workspace member count.
baseline.crate_rust_assignment: Assign each codex-rs .rs path to its nearest ancestor Cargo.toml; each Rust file is counted exactly once.

toolchain.default_build: Python-created B0 seed; native HIA B1, B2 and B3; B3 emits component objects; GNU ld links shared libraries.
toolchain.development_build: --seed-only uses the Python direct machine emitter and does not perform the native compiler generations.
remaining_work: native host interfaces required by the capability matrix
platform and architecture coverage required by Codex
complete compiler and runtime ownership closure beyond the bootstrap/component profile
toolchain.qualification_scope: B1/B2/B3 compiler byte equality and original-Rust differential tests of seek_sequence and utf8_boundaries.

interface.source_wire: u64 line_count, pattern_count, start, flags; u64 offsets[line_count+pattern_count+1]; concatenated UTF-8 strings; all integers little-endian

behavior: exact, trailing-whitespace, trim and Unicode punctuation matching passes
original pass precedence and first matching line
empty patterns, out-of-range starts, EOF and both line-ending modes

interface.source_wire: u64 max_bytes little-endian, then UTF-8 bytes

behavior: largest complete UTF-8 prefix within the byte budget
original Rust behavior for every valid string input
full UTF-8 validation before output publication

interface.source_wire: u64 original_utf8_byte_length, u64 budget, u64 window_start; up to four surrounding UTF-8 bytes

capabilities.next_implementation: Add HIA host-operation interfaces and owned asynchronous execution, then run the original process and tool integration cases.

filesystem and network isolation
platform sandbox setup and denial behavior
capabilities.next_implementation: Port policy evaluation and platform integration while preserving the existing sandbox environment contracts and denial tests.

native host operations for network, storage, processes and terminal interfaces

requirements: HIA owns the actual production dispatch and effects for the replaced scope
original Rust behavior and malformed-input cases pass without skipped or substituted oracles
existing protocol, CLI, configuration, persisted-session and SDK interfaces remain compatible
required platforms and app/exec host combinations pass
clean build, package installation and end-to-end use pass on the resulting source tree
regression fixtures, licensing and required release assets remain available
retirement.cleanup_rule: Remove superseded source and process artifacts only after the corresponding replacement satisfies these requirements. Build outputs and transient test files remain outside the repository.
